title: Operator Dialer: unified scaling controls, telemetry timeline, and change playback
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Goal: Build an Operator Dialer interface in Console that centralizes per-fleet scaling controls (target throughput, burst windows, min/max capacity), a telemetry timeline that visualizes throughput/latency/cost over time, and a change playback UI that lets operators step through scaling events and audit entries. This ticket covers the PM spec, acceptance criteria, and coordinating design/eng tasks for the first shipable iteration. Out of scope: deep simulations of autoscaler ML models, RBAC policy primitives (handled in separate ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Dialer control panel in Fleet view: set target RPS/TPU, burst window (seconds), min/max workers, and an immediate apply vs. staged rollout option
Telemetry timeline: pan/zoom, multi-series (throughput, p95 latency, token cost), and per-model breakdown filter
Change playback: list of scaling events with timestamps, actor, causal trigger (manual/policy/autoscaler), and ability to jump to state at event time
Audit entries persisted and linked to change playback; exportable CSV for a given time range
UI respects Dedicated capacity quotas and surfaces conflicts (e.g., requested throughput exceeds reserved capacity) with clear remediation steps
E2E smoke test that executes a manual scale up and verifies metric visibility and correct rollback when scaling fails
design_notes: Primary UX pattern: a compact dialer card anchored in the Fleet header with a detailed flyout for advanced tuning
Telemetry timeline uses bucketed sampling to keep client rendering under 200ms for 72h windows; provide a raw-download link for long-range analysis
Change playback should be memory-efficient: load event chunks on demand and show contextual snapshots (capacity config + active nodes)
Accessible keyboard navigation for dialer inputs and timeline keyboard shortcuts for play/pause/step
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (MVP): Frontend dialer + basic REST endpoints to mutate fleet scaling config; backend writes to audit log service; telemetry read from metrics index (last 30 days)
Phase 2: Add staged rollout option, simulation sandbox (non-destructive preview), and per-model throttles
Phase 3: Playback enhancements: integrate with job history, add rollback button tied to an automated safety checklist
Coordination: ENG to provide APIs by 2025-02-05; Design to deliver high-fidelity flyout by 2025-01-24
test_plan: Unit tests for dialer form validation (bounds checking, quota conflicts)
Integration test: mutate fleet config and assert audit event creation and metrics continuity
Perf test: timeline rendering with 72h of 1s-sampled telemetry under Chrome on an M-series instance
Chaos test: simulate failed scale up and verify automatic revert policy and operator notification
metrics: Primary: time-to-scale (seconds) for manual dialer changes
Secondary: operator MTTR for scaling-related incidents, number of manual interventions per week
Guardrails: p95 latency change within 10% of baseline after scale events, no unauthorized quota breaches
